correctness.rationale: Reconstructed S³ probability-normalized Hopf measure, scalar Jacobi harmonic orthogonality, degree k=a+b+2j multiplicities (k+1)², and Fourier block restriction to the theta=pi/4 Clifford torus. Each torus weight (m,n) with s=|m|+|n|<L gives exactly one positive eigenvalue sum of squared Jacobi evaluation coefficients; j=0 is nonzero, proving the diamond range and rank 2L²−2L+1. j=0 term is (s+1)2^(−s)binom(s,a)≥(s+1)/2^s≥L/2^(L−1); only four axial s=L−1 modes attain equality for L≥3 (all five at L=2). This establishes optimal pseudoinverse norm sqrt(2^(L−1)/L). Independently calculated exact rational Jacobi sums and Chebyshev Laurent coefficients for every frequency L=1..7 (L7 rank85, least 7/64), including normalized trace/rank identities; finite checks supplement all-L analytic proof.
